[[File:Weathered Nook.jpg|thumb|The flooded Nook.]]

The '''Weathered Nook''' was a small, well-hidden cave and home to [[Dorn Plainstalker]] and [[Prate Cloudseer]], found on the northern wall of [[Thousand Needles]]. It was flooded during the cataclysm, it's unknown if Dorn and Prate survived.

==How to locate==
Head north from [[Freewind Post]] until you reach the cliffs overlooking the needles. Follow the cliffs east until you come to a ramp leading up. This area is known as the Weathered Nook. {{coords|53|41|Thousand Needles}}
